annotations.title: Get Real-Time SEC Filing and Press Release Events (Polling, 24h, Cursor)

description: New SEC filings and company press releases as they arrive, from the same 24-hour event log that feeds the Signal8 real-time WebSocket, read by polling. Four channels: `filings` (every SEC EDGAR filing the moment Signal8 sees it: accession number, CIK, company, tickers, form, 8-K items when read, accepted time, filing link; on Forms 3/4/5, 144 and Schedule 13D/G the issuer is the subject and the filer is in reporting_owner), `filings.ai` (Signal8's analysis of a filing: event type, significance, summary, red flags, key figures; same id as the raw filing), `press_releases` (headline, issuer, tickers, published time, link) and `press_releases.ai` (analysis of a release, same id as the raw release). The analysis can arrive minutes or longer after the raw event. Without `since` the most recent matching events are returned, oldest first. Each response carries next_cursor: sent back as `since`, it returns only events that arrived after the previous call, so repeated calls poll for new events (for example "what filings came in for my watchlist since my last check"). has_more true means more events are available immediately. The log holds 24 hours: a `since` older than that returns the last 24 hours with cursor_expired true. One call examines at most 5,000 log entries, so a narrow filter can return no events with has_more true; next_cursor then continues after what was examined. Filters combine with and, values inside one filter with or. A figure Signal8 does not have never matches (an unknown market cap fails a market cap filter); market cap, exchange and security type are read off the first ticker; marketCapMax is exclusive. A filter a channel never carries (forms or CIKs on press releases, eventTypes or significance on the raw channels) is listed in warnings. A null field means not measured. An empty events list means nothing matched in what was examined. Signal8 Pro reads events live, with every filter and the since cursor. A free account gets a taste instead: the 5 most recent events that are at least 15 minutes old, filtered by channels and tickers only, with no cursor (since and the other filters need Pro); that response has tier "free", delayed_minutes 15 and an upgrade object with the Pro link.

ciks.description: SEC CIKs, zero padding optional (max 500). Filings channels only.

eventTypes.description: Analysis event types, e.g. ["offering", "reverse_split"]. Analysis channels only.

exchanges.description: Listing venues of the first ticker.

forms.description: SEC forms, e.g. ["8-K", "S-1", "4"]; a trailing * matches a family ("424B*"). Filings channels only.

marketCapMax.description: Maximum market cap in USD, exclusive (e.g. 300000000 for under $300M).

marketCapMin.description: Minimum market cap in USD, inclusive.

securityTypes.description: Security types of the first ticker, e.g. ["CS"] for common stock.

significance.description: Analysis significance levels. Analysis channels only.

since.description: A cursor from a previous event or the next_cursor of a previous call, verbatim. Omit for the most recent events.
